c.description:
Vancouver Kerrisdale Entire Detached House for Rent | Approx. 2,300 Sq. Ft.

Entire detached house for rent in the highly desirable Kerrisdale neighbourhood of Vancouver. Both the upper and lower levels have independent access. Private parking is available in the yard, with plenty of additional street parking on this quiet residential street.

Conveniently located just a 5-minute walk from Magee Secondary School and Maple Grove Elementary School. The house features new high-quality hardwood flooring installed in 2025, creating a bright, comfortable, and easy-to-maintain living space.

Rent: $5,500/month if long term // Available immediately // Month to month negotiable***

Located in Vancouver’s prestigious West Side, this warm and comfortable detached home comes with basic furnishings and is ideal for families looking for a short- to mid-term stay or a convenient transitional home.

The house offers 3 bedrooms upstairs, along with several flexible spaces that can be used as a 4th or 5th bedroom, home office, children’s playroom, study, or guest room, depending on your family’s needs.

Prime Location & Excellent Convenience

* Quiet and beautiful residential neighbourhood surrounded by mature trees
* Walk Score of approximately 95
* Close to major transit routes including R4, 49, 16 and 17
* Surrounded by excellent public and private schools, including Magee Secondary, Point Grey Secondary, and Maple Grove Elementary
* Approximately 10 minutes by car to UBC
* Walking distance to Kerrisdale Village, with supermarkets, cafés, restaurants, shops and everyday amenities
* Close to Kerrisdale Community Centre, library, parks and recreational facilities
* Just steps from the popular Arbutus Greenway, ideal for walking, jogging and cycling
* Approximately 10 minutes to the newly developed Oakridge Park shopping centre and SkyTrain station
